parts.title: Score with visible assumptions
parts.body: Use a common 1 to 5 scale for strategic fit, expected value, feasibility, data readiness, adoption effort, and risk. Keep raw measures beside the score: annual volume, expected time saved, error cost, and confidence in the estimate. Weights make priorities explicit; sensitivity checks show when a ranking is fragile.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Run a portfolio review
parts.body: Compare a customer service copilot with a fraud alert system. The copilot may have faster payback; fraud may protect a smaller number of much more consequential cases. Vary the risk weight and show how the ranking changes. Fund discovery on uncertain candidates before claiming a precise ROI.
parts.label: Apply
